entries.title: The Esports World Cup will reportedly move to Paris from Riyadh
entries.summary: Uncertainty in the Middle East is apparently forcing the location change.
entries.excerpt: This summer's Esports World Cup will be held in Paris, France, rather than its originally scheduled location of Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, due to the war in the Middle East,GamesBeatreports. According to the site, EWC organizers are telling stakeholders behind the scenes that the tournament will be moved to Paris this year, though there's been no public confirmation of the change. Rumors of a location swap have beenswirling for days.
